name: Sky Light Holdings Limited
summary: Sky Light Holdings Limited is an investment holding company in Shenzhen, founded in 2000, that designs, produces and sells digital imaging products to customers in the US, mainland China, the EU and Hong Kong. Its range includes home security and police cameras, video conferencing units, 360-degree and dashboard cameras, baby monitors and smart doorbells, with video analytics such as facial recognition. It also offers JDM and ODM manufacturing.
